newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello stands by Australia budget forecasts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello stands by Australia budget forecasts.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Monday the government stood by its 1996/97 budget forecasts for economic growth, jobs and unemployment.

"Let me make it entirely clear that the government does stand by its budget forecasts, and it stands by those forecasts in relation to growth, in relation to employment and in relation to unemployment," Costello told parliament.
"And ... let me say that because of the government's successful budget strategy, the economy and the economic prospects are coming together," he said.

In its budget for the year to June 30, 1997, the conservative Liberal-National government forecast economic growth of 3.5 percent, 1.5 percent employment growth and projected unemployment to fall to 8.25 percent by the June quarter.
Australia's unemployment rate was 8.7 percent, seasonally adjusted, in September.
